api: Ledger and verify_report remain local accounting APIs. child_observer.inspect_request and dispatch_development add the measured_profile fixed-verifier local development path through runner._launch. No CLI, installed activation or generic/native dispatch authority is added.
trust_boundary: Privileged same-host producer, protected non-shared filesystem store, trusted observation adapter and separately provisioned issuer public-key pin. A signature authenticates the configured issuer, not the truth of measurements or runtime origin. Source hash identifies child_ledger.py only; full source manifest supplied separately.
store_ownership: Owner must allocate a dedicated local partition and exactly one protected store for that allocation. create does not reserve an external/global budget and cannot detect duplicate stores, rollback by a privileged owner, filesystem cloning, other hosts or double issuance of allocations. Those require the owning budget interface; do not assert global feasibility.

field_mapping.children: body.children contains exactly one ordered row per declared child; missing reservation/dispatch/completion/settlement is JSON null and remains UNKNOWN
field_mapping.reservation_sha256: child.reservation.sha256; sha256 of canonical envelope without sha256 member, not a whole-file hash
field_mapping.issuer_identity: each envelope.issuer_identity; externally pinned public key and exact producer_identity required
field_mapping.issued_at: child.reservation.body.issued_at; owner-supplied recorded instant, not independently authenticated wall time
field_mapping.completion: child.completion.body.resource_rows contains measured_amount; same selected observation bytes must bind reservation, service state and rows
field_mapping.settlement_sha256: child.settlement.sha256; same digest convention as reservation
field_mapping.settlement_rows: child.settlement.body.resource_rows includes both measured_amount and settled_amount_or_UNKNOWN
field_mapping.separate_states: completion and settlement carry service_performed, resource_measured and financial_or_external_settlement separately

amount_encoding: Canonical nonnegative rational strings: 0, 7, 3/2. No floats, estimates, negative values or nonreduced fractions. UNKNOWN allowed only measurement/settlement, never limits or reservations.
budget_input: Exact selected vfy.child-resource-budget/1 bytes: schema, budget_id, task_key, task_identity, parent_start_sha256, resource_rows with limit. Not Engineer shared-resource-budget/2. Engineer/global owner must explicitly supply a dedicated compatible partition; never silently coerce unsupported axes.
lifecycle: create binds exact original START bytes, selected basis path/hash, task subject, predeclared ordered child population and exact partition bytes
reserve takes flock, checks remaining local allocation, durably publishes signed reservation before returning; each child and attempt unique
dispatch_record records intent after reservation, grants no permission and does not prove any launch occurred; existing Run authority/custody gate remains independently required

complete requires dispatch intent and an explicitly selected observation file with schema vfy.child-observation/1, reservation_id, service_performed and resource_rows exactly equal to the supplied fields; adapter truth is a trust assumption, not a measurement generated by this ledger
settle binds exact reservation and completion digest once; known service and measured amount settle local accounting only; financial/external settlement remains UNKNOWN

UNKNOWN service or measurement retains its reserved amount; observed overrun increases exposure; performed-but-unsettled retains max(reserved, measured); overrun is visible and blocks additional reservation
missing child records remain UNKNOWN; absent measurements are never zero; no release/cancel/retry or amendment endpoint is provided
interruption_and_replay: pending.json is quarantine after interrupted publication; never auto-clear it or retry service. Successful publication with lost response reconciles read-only via same persisted receipt. Duplicate reserve/completion/settlement refuses. Snapshot verification is historical correspondence, NOT freshness. Consumer must retain its accepted revision/digest; minimum_revision rejects older revisions but cannot detect same-revision equivocation without retained digest. Current store and receipt custody remain trusted. No inherited old UNKNOWN context is reopened.
verification: verify_report(report_bytes, independently_configured_trust, exact_start_bytes, selected_basis, exact_budget_bytes, minimum_revision=0) verifies selected bytes, signatures and cross-record semantic correspondence. Signature or correspondence failure is refusal/UNKNOWN, never permission. Readers must preserve envelope/body mapping and full unsupported dimension states.
compatibility_departures: Requires an additive Engineer schema/2 reader; current schema/1 does not accept this envelope or receipt semantics
Exact raw START digest replaces schema/1 canonical-reserialization digest; whitespace-distinct START bytes are distinct
Rational strings replace legacy numeric amounts for this profile
A dedicated local partition is not overall resource-vector reservation; unsupported axes and external settlement remain UNKNOWN

The measured_profile now supplies the fixed-verifier observation and pre-dispatch reservation adapter. Engineer still owns orchestration, selected observer/runtime trust, companion validation and exact V22 invocation/consumer acceptance.
authority_and_custody: Ledger records remain authority_granted=false and automatic_retry=false. The separate measured_profile launches only its independently pinned verifier under explicit local development scope. It does not issue or consume native/action authority. Existing generic authorization/nonce/replay/custody chain is unchanged. Neither accounting nor direct-child observations supply stopped/lifetime proof.
platform_scope: Ledger historical checks were macOS/Python3.13. New measured_profile runs parent macOS CPython3.13 with independently pinned child Engineer Python3.14; os.wait4 and local POSIX locking required. Installed distribution, other environments and network filesystems unverified.
acceptance: Run acknowledges this bounded producer contract only. Engineer consumption, integration, joint acceptance, activation, migration and release are NOT established. Full resource feasibility and research closure remain OPEN.

parent_start_numeric_profile.domain: If present, exact JSON integer tokens 0 through 9223372036854775807 inclusive. Both fields may be absent for prior minimal START compatibility. Negative, -0, float, exponent, boolean, string, null, overflow and duplicate-key encodings refuse. No time plausibility or freshness attested.
parent_start_numeric_profile.other_values: All other fields, including nested lookalike names and task identity, retain global canonical +/-9007199254740991 integer bounds. No floats anywhere. UTF-8, depth, duplicate, surrogate, syntax and document-size checks apply.
parent_start_numeric_profile.identity: SHA-256 of complete original START bytes unchanged; decoder neither rewrites nor projects the input for identity. Metadata ints are not copied into signed events. Global load.py/canon.py and signed serialization remain byte-identical.
parent_start_numeric_profile.compatibility: Producer version and child_ledger.py pin change; schema/2 event mapping, rational amounts and accounting semantics unchanged. Existing historical dev1 receipts retain their original producer pins; do not relabel or resign them.

measured_profile.api: vfy.child_observer.inspect_request(ledger, request_bytes, input_bytes, selected_observer); dispatch_development(ledger, request_bytes, input_bytes, selected_observer=..., recorded_at=..., interrupt=False, timeout_seconds=30)
measured_profile.selection: Externally pin child_observer.identity() including observer module, runner, verifier code, verifier source pins and independent runtime fixture. Exact reviewed interpreter path/resolved bytes required; requester cannot nominate another executable. Standard library, cryptography, PyYAML and interpreter tree remain trusted local installation, not fully measured origin.
measured_profile.input: Exact Engineer child-dispatch-request/1 bytes and stdin. Parent file bytes must match existing selected ledger START, task/attempt/child/cwd/empty environment/interpreter match request. Verifier script and dev2 five-source pins fixed by reviewed profile. No arbitrary command/environment/FD forwarding.
measured_profile.development_scope: Explicit opt-in local development verifier only. Not execute_authorized_command native/action authority. Existing generic gate/nonce/custody chains remain unchanged and cannot be bypassed for arbitrary actions through this fixed-job API.
measured_profile.child_attempt_mapping: Reservation attempt_id = exact request attempt_id + colon + child_id. Parent operation/attempt remain exact. Signed binding pins original request SHA and identity; unique per-child attempt requirement preserved.
sequence: inspect all exact inputs and selected observer
reserve all three declared axes through existing locked ledger
reuse runner._launch with opt-in per-PID observer, empty environment and bounded preselected stdin
write actual observation file, existing completion and settlement
persist signed acquisition companion and return exact receipt/report/output bytes
measured_profile.reservation: Per-child accounting hold: 262144 captured bytes, 10 CPU seconds, 30 interval seconds. Total selected partition must admit holds; no claim of globally allocated capacity. CPU is posthoc accounting, NOT hard quota. Wall timeout bounds waiting with cleanup overhead; interval may exceed30 and overrun is recorded.

measurement.cpu: Per-PID os.wait4 ru_utime and ru_stime exact rational representations via Fraction.from_float; no further decimal/float rounding. OS resolution applies, not mathematically exact physical time. Fixed reviewed verifier does not spawn subprocesses; no general descendant attribution promise. Missing usage UNKNOWN.
measurement.wall: monotonic_ns from immediately before Popen through runner cleanup; rational seconds. Includes startup, IO waiting and cleanup, not full parent observer cost.
measurement.output: Exact retained stdout+stderr byte count, capped131072 each; both pipes drained using existing runner. Truncated output is not total emitted bytes and cannot mark service PERFORMED.
measurement.service: PERFORMED only for started, zero exit, no timeout/truncation/interruption, known usage and valid verifier result state. Otherwise UNKNOWN; error or interruption is not proof service did not execute.
measurement.interruption: Explicit development control SIGSTOPs observed child then existing timeout/group cleanup applies. Parent death/exceptions retain existing reserved/intent state with no retry. No proof escaped descendants stopped. Missing acquisition companion cannot be represented as measured provenance.

measured_profile.companion_contract: To assert measured origin, require signature trust + exact selected observer/runtime profile + signed *.binding.json + *.acquisition.json. Bind binding SHA to request and reservation; acquisition binds observer, binding file SHA, observation/completion/settlement digests and captured output hashes. A schema/2 ledger alone is accounting correspondence, not measured origin. Consumer must refuse missing/mismatched companions for this claim.
measured_profile.freshness: One protected owner store per allocation assumed. No store cloning/rollback resistance or cross-host guarantee. Duplicate reservation/dispatch is refused and never reset. Caller-supplied recorded_at is not observed wall clock proof.
measured_profile.retained_limits: settlement-verifier/render-verifier may run only when their exact future payload requests are produced. Undispatched slots remain UNKNOWN. Observer/signing/verification after selected snapshot not recursively complete or charged here. Host/provider/memory/storage/financial/global lifecycle remain UNKNOWN.
measured_profile.supported_environment: Actual development checks on local macOS: parent CPython3.13, selected child Engineer Python3.14 exact fixture hash; os.wait4 required. Other environments not verified.
measured_profile.V22_scope: V22 inputs preflight validated read-only. Its private key and protected sibling stores are not used in Run-owned development tests; no claim of actual V22 dispatch, adoption or settlement. Engineer must call reviewed API against its exact store once under its ownership.

common_capacity_profile: Additive spec/child-ledger/common-capacity-contract.json defines independent common pool, dispatch_common and per-request scoped trust. Existing unbound development path unchanged; pool-bound ledgers refuse legacy path. CPU/wall remain observations.
